metaDescription: Order custom full color mechanical pencils for your brand. Perfect for trade shows and giveaways. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Full color decoration on mechanical pencils lets you reproduce logos, photos, or complex designs with vivid detail. Unlike standard one- or two-color imprints, full color gives you the freedom to create a pencil that stands out on any desk. The uni-ball Chroma Pencil, for example, offers a smooth 0.5mm writing experience and provides a generous barrel for your artwork. Marketing directors often choose these for promotional events where brand recognition matters. HR directors and safety managers appreciate the durability and professional look. Order custom full color mechanical pencils for your next campaign.
